pins.note: Manually reviewed 3 November site snapshot. Its specification, extension, guides and changelog text matches upstream commit 7205250 (2 November) apart from site formatting: code-block titles, heading anchors and link prefixes. Since the 29 October pin: Companies without an OAuth issuer (850a46d), auth.disabled, extension content in messages, session_ended, poppy_dlg and poppy-delegation+jwt, and the Links, Disclosures and UCP extensions. Snapshot hashes are the exact pin. 0.3 was published on 4 November 2026 with this text and is frozen: its pages and changelog entries were unchanged on 9 November, so drift checks only its own pages and changelog entry titles.

Manually reviewed 10 November site snapshot of the 0.4 draft, replacing the 9 November pin (b2569c5). Since then: Operations version 3 (agent approvals, a required approver, required terms), the Browser Control extension, and the Session header on website pages fetched without a browser; the 34 earlier changelog entries keep their titles. The pinned kit is upstream kit/company at commit a2f16ec apart from links the site rewrites to /docs/0.4/, and its reference pages match this snapshot. The home page walkthroughs were not extracted: the snapshot script can not read the new bundle; they are examples, not requirements. 0.4 is still a draft: a newer snapshot gets its own dated directory and replaces this pin after review.
